task: CIFAR-10 bird/cat count supervision with a genuinely restricted fixed linear head
feature_source: Existing frozen ResNet18 IMAGENET1K_V1 feature cache; official deterministic evaluation transform
projection: L2-normalize each original 512-dimensional feature; center on all 10000 unlabeled training-pool rows; project onto the first 32 covariance eigenvectors; divide each score by its pool standard deviation; append bias 1 and divide all 33 coordinates by sqrt(33). Eigenvector sign: largest-absolute coordinate positive. Test rows use this fixed training-pool transform.
projection_label_use: PCA uses features from the binary training pool without concept labels, counts or test examples.
sampling: Six disjoint count-stratified draws from the existing CIFAR training pool; exclude all 216 images in the original full-row-rank cohort. True labels are used only to construct bags and evaluate semantic accuracy.
head_initialization: All 33 coordinates independently Uniform(-1/sqrt(33),1/sqrt(33)); bias included; one shared initial head across the three prefix metrics; no filtering or balancing
metric_rule: Parameter diagonals: ones(33), geomspace(0.5,2,33), and the reverse of the latter. Fixed coordinate ordering after the fixed projection; no per-head metric design.
eta_rule: For each draw, eta = 0.8*4/(2*||X||_op^2*(4+1)); shared across all heads, prefix metrics and continuations. Uses the independently audited disjoint-bag Hessian bound, never a bagwise capture threshold.
update: w_next = w + eta*diag(M)*X^T R(Xw); exact complete-count posterior refreshed every update; R=2*(posterior unary-sigmoid); twice summed detached BCE convention
saved_states: Every parameter state, including initialization and final state.
capture: First strict global sum_b log(E_b)>-log(2); all 24 bags enter the product
well_fitted: All bag hard counts legal; mean bag evidence >=0.95; minimum per-image modal probability >=0.90
resolved: Final state well-fitted and same complete 96-bit code throughout the final 101 states
other_fixed_diagonal: Identity or forward prefix switches to reverse; reverse prefix switches to forward
adaptive_adverse_diagonal: At every step choose the coordinate with the smallest captured signed margin. For g=X^T R and v=z_i*X_i*g, choose each parameter diagonal 0.5 where v>=0 and 2 where v<0. This minimizes that coordinate's signed drift over the diagonal box [0.5,2]^33; uses captured signs and current training state only.
evaluation: All model runs and continuations on the four evaluation sets. A disjoint pilot used the same settings.
